title: Full Stack Developer
tagline: Own the whole application, from the browser to the database
description: Combine frontend and backend skills in one track: HTML, CSS and JavaScript, a modern framework, Node.js and Express on the server, a database of your choice and finally containerised deployment with CI.
audience: Developers who want to build and deploy complete web applications on their own

stages.title: HTML
stages.description: Semantic page structure, forms and media.

stages.title: CSS
stages.description: Layout, responsive design and a design system with Bootstrap.

stages.title: JavaScript
stages.description: Language fundamentals, the DOM, fetch and asynchronous code.

stages.title: Angular or React
stages.description: Component-based UI with routing, forms and HTTP.

stages.title: Node.js
stages.description: Server-side JavaScript: modules, files, HTTP and configuration.

stages.title: Express
stages.description: REST APIs with routing, middleware, validation and authentication.

stages.title: Database
stages.description: Pick relational (MySQL) or document (MongoDB) storage and connect it to your API.

stages.title: Deployment
stages.description: Containerise the app with Docker, automate builds with GitHub Actions and deploy to a host.
stages.topicNote: Deployment is taught through the Docker and GitHub Actions tutorials and the deployment lessons at the end of the Express tutorial; choose the host that fits your project.

seo.title: Full Stack Developer Learning Path
seo.description: Roadmap from HTML, CSS and JavaScript through Angular or React, Node.js, Express, a database and deployment with Docker and CI.
